messages.author: f2659346bc7923d6
messages.subject: SEM: Mediation adjusted to confounders
parts:
Dear all,

The classical mediation does not account for confounders, but I need to test in my models.

So far, my literature research drove me to Coffman, Struct Equ Modeling. 2011 Jan 1; 18(3): 357–369.
He suggests the use of Propensity Scores.

Does anyone know how to implement this or another approach to adjust mediator and outcome for confounders?


Thanks in advance,

Best regards,
Vinícius

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: SEM: Mediation adjusted to confounders
parts:
Propensity scores are calculated by predicting group membership using nonrandomized covariates (e.g., fitting a binary logistic regression to a binary grouping variable, then saving the predicted/fitted values, using them as propensity scores).  I'm not sure how this applies to your study... Do you have a categorical X or M?  

Regardless, this sounds like a general SEM question more than a lavaan programming question.  Perhaps you could find more feedback on SEMNET:

http://www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html

Terry

Many thanks.

parts: I found a way diving into the internet.  Besides the work of Coffman et al. 2011, I found really useful the work of Butera et al. 2014.
My M is categorical, and I will made my X categorical splitting in the median.

If X is continuous, you would lose information by creating arbitrary groups, often yielding spurious results.  Consider reading this article on the topic of dichotomizing continuous variables:

http://dx.doi.org/10.1037//1082-989X.7.1.19

Terry

Dear Terry and all lavaan friends,

So far, no one has answered my question in SEMNET.

Then, I would propose a question that better fits the group.

Does any of you perform formal mediation in lavaan adjusting mediator and outcome for a latent confounder?

Where:
X =  continuous latent variable
M = dichotomous latent variable (adjusted for a latent confounder)
Y = continuous latent variable (adjusted for a latent confounder)

Best regards,
Vinícius
